x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-item-confidential-papers (REQ-ACP-001). An agenda item and each paper say whether they are public; a non-public item names the readers outside its body who may read it. The meeting pack and the publication leave a non-public item's papers out (REQ-ACP-005). The read rules that keep a non-public item and its papers from everyone else (REQ-ACP-002) are not in this fragment yet: they need the item's governance body on the item for a $memberOf rule, and a test through OpenRegister's own evaluator.

public.title: Public
public.description: Whether the item and its papers are public. A non-public item (besloten punt) is left out of the meeting pack and the publication, and its papers are not public either.

authorisedReaders.title: Authorised readers
authorisedReaders.description: Nextcloud user ids outside the meeting's body who may read this item and its papers while it is not public (Lezers toevoegen), for example an external accountant.

public.title: Public
public.description: Whether the paper is public (Openbaar) or not (Besloten). A paper of a non-public agenda item is not public.
